description: Rules from spec/07-conformance.md about the conformance declaration itself (CON-5, CON-6, CORE-7).

vectors.name: conformance/declaration-must-be-array
vectors.description: A bare string is not a list of classes.

vectors.name: conformance/unknown-class-rejected
vectors.description: 'provenance' is not a conformance class of this format.

vectors.name: conformance/declared-lineage-must-exist
vectors.description: Declaring lineage without a lineage member is a claim the record does not back.

vectors.name: conformance/declared-recipe-must-exist
vectors.description: The same applies to recipe: the class is the member.

vectors.name: conformance/core-declaration-accepted
vectors.description: core needs no member of its own: every valid record satisfies it.

vectors.name: conformance/declared-lineage-accepted
vectors.description: The declaration matches the members the record carries.

vectors.name: conformance/undeclared-class-accepted
vectors.description: Under-declaring is a SHOULD violation (CORE-7) and a warning, never a rejection; absence of a declaration says nothing about the members (CORE-8).

steps: Press the record into the folder.
